shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Joy stands at the worktable folding green wrapping paper around a gift box. She presses the folded edge down with both palms, slides a strip of tape across it with her right hand, and answers cheerfully toward the camera without stopping her work. She nods once on the words one o'clock and her braids bounce. After the line her lips close into a bright smile, she turns the wrapped box around once on the table and pats its top with both hands.
